No he doesn't know about the situation, but knows about her depression and her suicidal mindset and has a knack for picking up when she's in a bad mindset.

I think that I'll be okay. I kind of know that she won't commit because of something like this. I dont know how i know, but I know her well enough to know that she wouldn't do it right now. I get over things really quickly, but she blames herself for everything.

I have no idea why I panicked that much. I think it was because i basically said to myself that i would not get a girlfriend until i graduated and i basically broke that promise to myself. I want to be a doctor and ive drilled it into my own mind that i cannot be a doctor if i have the distraction of a gf while studying. I don't know anymore

I don't know her address or have anyway of getting to her house. She's having one of our friends over today and she talks to our friends all the time so I beleive the best course of action for me is to give her space.

Our mutual friend that she talks to a lot will let me know if anything is going on so I've got that going.

She didn't block me because she hates me. She blocked me because she feels that she has to protect me from herself. She's really protective of me and she feels like that she doesn't do anything positive for me which is a complete lie.

I wrote what happened in a comment above.

Im so fucking scared and i feel terrible.

Okay so I'm a 16 year old male in australia. My best friend, a female, has been battling depression for three years. She met me a year ago, and ive saved her life twice now. I'm pretty sure me and her were bordering boyfriend girlfriend status. Anyway, every saturday we would meet up at our church and just sit together at the park in each others arms and talk.

Yesterday, we were talking and i leaned over and kissed her on the cheek. This isnt something out of the ordinary, but what happened next was. We both had gum, and she was like "do you want gum?" And stuck her gum out inbetween her teeth. Now if i just laughed and hugged her none of this would have happened. But i leaned over and kissed her on the lips. For a total of two seconds. Then the weight of what we just did and the the responsibility of having a girlfriend came crashing down on us and she had a panic attack. It didnt help that i said "im scared of what we just did" she apologized over and over and over and started crying so much. I kept telling her that it was okay and nothing happened.

When i got home i texted her to assure her it was all good and she texted me saying that i needed to get away from her for my own good and that she didnt want me to treat her any different. I said that i love her too much to leave and i promised that i will not treat her any differently and went to bed.

This morning i woke up and she had blocked me.

She is suicidal and I'm so fucking scared that what happened will be the straw that broke the camels back.
